name: weeknight vegetarian ragu
instructions:
The weeknight base-substrate system: cook a big batch of protein pasta once, keep it all week, and finish portions in different directions.

=== THE BASE SUBSTRATE ===

1. Cook AS MUCH PASTA AS POSSIBLE.
2. SAUTÉ an entire pack of VEGAN BEEF CRUMBLES (or ground beef) in OLIVE OIL with GARLIC and simple herbs — THYME/OREGANO.
3. TOSS the pasta with the meat and PASTA WATER.
4. SAVE IN A TUB — this is the substrate for the whole week.

=== VARIANT A — TOMATO ===

Tomato with MUSHROOMS, ONIONS, or EGGPLANT: sauté them, then add to the substrate.

=== VARIANT B — CREAM (VEGAN) ===

CASHEW CREAM or a vegan SILKEN TOFU sauce (deliberately unspecified — whatever's on hand).

=== VARIANT C — GREEN + LEMON ===

Add STEAMED BROCCOLI or GREEN BEANS and LEMON.
notes:
=== THE SUBSTRATE SYSTEM ===

Restructured (September 2026) from a one-pan dish into a WEEK-LONG SUBSTRATE: the pasta + crumbles + garlic + herb base gets made once at maximum volume, lives in a tub, and individual portions get finished as variant A (tomato + vegetable) or variant B (vegan cream). Still the most natural way to use SOY BEEF CRUMBLES, which can be hard to place — the crumbles disappear into the base and let the finishing sauce lead.

=== WHOLE TOMATOES — TOMATO PASTE IS CLASHING ===

You really want WHOLE tomatoes here (canned, regular or fire-roasted — not crushed). Tomato paste is CLASHING.

=== FLEXIBILITY IS THE POINT ===

Any ingredient can basically be omitted. Any noodle works — SPAGHETTI is my pick. Parmesan over the top.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[bolognese]] / [[spaghetti-and-meatballs]]: the real-deal ragus — long-simmered, protein-forward. This is the no-ceremony weeknight end of that family.
- [[ratatouille]]: the same vegetable crowd (eggplant/pepper/tomato), french and vegetable-first instead of crumble-and-noodle.
